TASK, two parts:

PART A — add a department-agnostic convenience layer to factory/runrecord.py (keep every existing function and its exact behavior; tests/test_runrecord.py must stay green):
1. read_release(department_dir: Path) -> dict|None — reads <department_dir>/releases/current (a text file naming the pinned release dir) then <department_dir>/releases/<name>/manifest.json, returning {'hash':..., 'source_ref':...}; returns None if anything is missing/unreadable (never raises).
2. emit_record(state_dir, *, department, node, status, epoch=0, attempt=1, round=None, release=None, trigger=None, engine=None, model=None, auth_class=None, usage=None, cost=None, duration_ms=None, errors=(), artifacts=(), receipts=(), evaluator=None, approval=None, external_actions_taken=0) -> Path — fills schema/rev/run_id/ts, builds via build_record, appends via append_record. Timestamps use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().
3. timed_emit(state_dir, department, node, **kwargs) context manager — measures wall duration_ms, defaults status 'ok', and on an exception inside the block emits status 'error' with the exception class name in errors then re-raises.
Add focused tests for these three to tests/test_runrecord.py (at least 4 new 'def test_' functions there).

PART B — wire EVERY listed podcast daily-chain node so each invocation appends exactly one runs-v2 record to the department state dir, using the factory package import (the daily trigger exports PYTHONPATH=<repo>, so 'from factory import runrecord' works; tests may import the same way — read the existing tests/ for the pattern). For each node (sense_estate, pipeline_sensor, publish_verifier, manifest_sensor, dag_supervisor, compare_charter, fingerprint_dedup, escalate_outbox): at the end of its main path write the record with department='podcast', node=<module name>, status 'ok' on success or 'error' with error codes on failure, trigger={'kind':'time','id':'podcast-daily','dedupe_key':'<UTC date>-<node>'}, release=read_release(<department dir>), engine/model/auth_class/usage/cost=None (script nodes), duration_ms measured, artifacts=[paths of receipt/observation files this run wrote, as strings], external_actions_taken=0. FAIL CLOSED: if the record append itself fails, log via the logging module and exit nonzero — a record gap must be visible, never swallowed. PRESERVE EXISTING BEHAVIOR EXACTLY: escalate_outbox's durable-marker dedup and its crash-safety test, dag_supervisor's observation/incident writes, every node's CLI flags and outputs, and all existing tests must stay green. Do not change what any node senses or writes besides adding the one record append.

tests/test_podcast_v2_records.py — at least 8 tests using tmp_path state dirs and the nodes' existing test fixtures/patterns (read tests/test_records_integrity.py and other podcast tests first): each wired node's happy path appends exactly one valid record (validate via factory.runrecord.validate_record); a forced node failure appends a status 'error' record AND the node still exits nonzero; release fields are threaded when a releases/current + manifest.json fixture exists and are None when absent; dedupe_key carries the UTC date and node name; a simulated append failure (monkeypatch append_record to raise) makes the node exit nonzero; records are valid JSON lines readable via json.loads per line.

VERIFY (the checker runs this): 'python3 loopfactory.py check' — the FULL suite plus your new tests must pass. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 8 new 'def test_' in test_podcast_v2_records.py, or the verify command failing.

CONTEXT (locked owner decision, 2026-08-02): every run has a first-class run_id, and review cards must carry it so the board and Linear cross-navigate. Today create_review_card.py accepts --run-id but only folds it into a one-way sha256 row_hash — it is stored nowhere readable.

CHANGE: keep the existing row_hash computation byte-identical (dedup depends on it), and ADDITIONALLY store the run_id: (1) the ledger row gains 'run_id': <value or 'unknown' when the flag is absent>; (2) the receipt written to --out gains the same 'run_id' field; (3) if the card body/description template mentions identifiers, append a plain 'run: <run_id>' line — read the file first and only do this if a body template exists; otherwise skip (3) silently. No PHI, no content changes otherwise, all existing flags preserved.

tests/test_review_card_runid.py — at least 4 tests, read the existing create_review_card tests/fixtures first and reuse their fake-transport pattern (never a real Linear call): run with --run-id stores it in ledger row and receipt; run WITHOUT --run-id stores 'unknown' in both; row_hash for a fixed (item_id, run_id) input is unchanged from the pre-change algorithm (assert against the literal sha256 the old code produced for a fixed input — compute it in the test with hashlib); ledger append still occurs exactly once per invocation.

VERIFY: 'python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 4 new 'def test_' functions, or the verify command failing.
